topic: A traveler's flight is delayed, causing them to miss an important event
text: Hey, I can't believe you're stuck there at the airport, of all places, when you should have been there, in the middle of all the action. I know how much this meant to you, and to see it slip away because of a dumb flight delay... it's like the universe is playing the cruellest joke ever. But listen, you've handled way tougher things than this. Your spirit, your strength, it shines through, even in the messiest of moments. Those people there, they might have missed out on seeing you in person, but they know who you are, and they know how amazing you are. And you, you keep on rising above, no matter what. I'm right here, cheering you on, always. Let’s make the next chance count even more, okay?
